body:
If you break a block you get teleported. 
Thats it enjoy a hard challenge to play with your friends or alone .
There is a 15% chance of a text showing up saying : You got lucky... In red , it indicates that you will not get teleported.
I made it because it was unplayable and way too hard.
If you make a video dont gatekeep the mod and give me a shoutout.

 

 

Check gameplay in my channel : https://www.youtube.com/@Jr_Anas.
